    """Extend a diagonal run of a non-background color along its diagonal."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = grid[0][0]

        # Find adjacent diagonal pairs; continue from an endpoint when its outward ray exists.
        directions = set()
        for i, (r1, c1) in enumerate(pts):

                if abs(dr) == abs(dc) and dr != 0:

            while 0 <= r < h and 0 <= c < w:

                    out[r][c] = color
                r += dr; c += dc
    return out
